articleTitle: Performance Analysis of 250kW Grid-Connected Photovoltaic System
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The utilization of renewable energy sources such as solar and wind power for the creation of electrical energy has become increasingly prevalent in response to the growing demand for electricity. The incorporation of renewable energy sources into the system is crucial for efficient energy consumption. Directly injecting power from renewable energy sources into the grid is a challenging task. Therefore, the system requires power electronic inverters to serve as a connection between renewable energy sources and the grid or load. This research examines the performance of a 250 KW grid connected to a solar system under three different input source scenarios. The inverter generates a clean sinusoidal voltage of 415 V in three phases, which is then used to supply power to the grid and the three-phase load. This study offers several additional benefits, including reduced switching losses, decreased voltage stress of dv/dt on switches, and improved electromagnetic interference. The MATLAB/Simulink software is used to simulate and evaluate the performance of a 250 KW grid. The accuracy of the results will be confirmed.

articleTitle: Exploratory Analysis of Heart Attack and Breast Cancer Early Stage Prediction
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This paper involves the development of a web based platform with an integrated machine learning algorithm to address problems pertaining to heart disease and breast cancer. It enables users to select either the heart attack or breast cancer datasets and use machine learning models such as Logistic Regression, K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN), Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest and XG Boost. The website provides basic information about the datasets such as the total number of records in a dataset, number of classes in a dataset, and also allows users to generate graphs for better visualization of the data. The evaluation of the performance of each of the models is based on various metrics such as accuracy, F1 score, precision, recall and mean squared error. This way it is possible to assess the performance of the models in relation to each of the available data sets which makes it easy for users to pick the most effective model. There are also inputs for the users which would be their health indicators like age, sex, level of cholesterol, heart rate among others. Using these values as well as the picked model, the website estimates the possibility of the user developing heart disease or breast cancer. Apart from predicting health risks, there is an emphasis on the evaluation of health risks by different machine learning models and thus assists users in finding the most accurate prediction model regarding their healthcare problems. Overall, the website provides both predictive healthcare insights and a deeper understanding of how various algorithms perform in real-world scenarios.

articleTitle: Exploring Model Predictive Direct Torque Control for In-Wheel Switched Reluctance Motors in Electric Vehicle Propulsion
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The in-wheel switched reluctance motor (IWSRM) is becoming increasingly important in the ongoing transition toward electrification in the automotive industry. This technology offers high efficiency due to its simple design and lack of permanent magnets, making it a cost-effective option compared to other polyphase machines. Moreover, integrating the motor into the wheel eliminates the need for complex transmission systems, reducing the overall size and weight of the vehicle while potentially increasing interior space. However, a significant challenge of IWSRM lies in controlling its complexity to optimize performance, particularly in terms of torque ripple reduction. To address this challenge, this paper proposes an enhanced model predictive direct torque control (MPDTC) approach, which involves selecting candidate voltage vectors in an optimized switching sequence. This strategy aims to mitigate torque ripple across various speeds and loads. Additionally, the sector arrangement selects voltage vectors with predictive control parameters to further enhance performance under different load conditions. The 12/16 IWSRM is developed using finite element analysis and the identified parameters are utilized to implement the control algorithm. The proposed model is validated and simulated using MATLAB/Simulink, analyzing motor performance in terms of speed, torque, and current under different vehicle propulsion conditions. Furthermore, a hardware setup is included to verify the real-time complexity of the system.

articleTitle: HIL Simulation Design and Considerations for Automated Manual Transmission ECU
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Hardware in loop simulation concept is quite ubiquitous in embedded system testing due to its advantages. Now a days its importance is increasing as technology is advancing more and systems are getting more complex. Embedded systems are used across all industrial domain from medical to automotive to aerospace. The intention of this paper is to bring in more clarity in procedure and steps involved about implementing hardware in loop simulation for Automated Manual Transmission ECU, which will help in seamless and faster integration of AMT ECU on HIL and available for test functionality during development, which will reduce development cycle time and cost. This paper takes you through various stages of HIL implementation and describes challenges involved and how to solve them also it describes certain consideration to keep in mind while achieving closed loop HIL simulation for example like hardware card selection and its configurations. Then it gives bit of idea about version management for HIL simulation artifacts.

articleTitle: An Enhanced Repetitive Control Framework for Adaptive Neuro-Fuzzy Learning Grid-Connected Inverter with Current Control and Frequency Adaptability
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This work proposes an advanced repeated control method (RCM) for a frequency adaptable grid-connected inverter based on fuzzy current control. The primary goal of the suggested strategy is to lower total harmonic distortion (THD) by adjusting the FIR filter in accordance with shifting grid frequencies while maintaining resonant frequencies that match both the fundamental and harmonic grid frequencies. When it is necessary that the sampling frequency ratio be an integer, the repeated control system is chosen due to its high efficiency in tracking periodic signals and low output total harmonic distortion (THD). The RCM’s resonant frequencies will deviate from the actual grid’s fundamental and harmonic frequencies in an industrial setting where the ratio may not be an integer. As a result, the system’s performance may be negatively impacted. against determine whether the suggested control method improves performance, it is compared against a conventional repeated control strategy that uses a PI controller. Through trials conducted at various frequencies, the control approach is assessed in grid-connected mode. The suggested controller successfully demonstrates its superiority over alternative control schemes with regard to the inverter systems’ THD level and component harmonic.

articleTitle: Visualizing Machine Learning Models for Enhanced Financial Decision-Making and Risk Management
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This study emphasizes how crucial it is to visualize machine learning models, especially for the banking industry, in order to improve interpretability and support predictions in high-stakes financial settings. Visual tools enable performance improvements and support the creation of innovative financial models by offering crucial insights into the algorithmic decision-making processes. Within a financial machine learning framework, the research uses visually guided experiments to make important concepts, such risk assessment and portfolio allocation, more understandable. The study also examines variations in trading tactics and how they relate to risk appetite, coming to the conclusion that the frequency of portfolio rebalancing is negatively correlated with risk tolerance. Finding these ideas is made possible in large part by visualization. The study concludes by presenting a novel method of locally stochastic asset weighing, where visualization facilitates data extraction and validation. This highlights the usefulness of these methods in furthering the field of financial machine learning research.

articleTitle: A Systematic Approach to Mitigate Power Consumption Challenges in Vehicle Key Systems Using Modern Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Modern vehicle key systems are evolving to incorporate advanced wireless technologies that optimize customer comfort, security, and safety. Integrating these advancements will cause significant challenges to non-rechargeable battery available in vehicle key fob. This paper proposes a systematic approach by enhancing customer comfort using the modern Type-C charging method with rechargeable batteries. A prototype design of a charging circuit is proposed for integrating a Type-C charging method into the vehicle key charging system. This leverages the advantages of Type-C USB, including its reversible connector design with its ability to deliver power in both directions, and with support for USB Power Delivery (PD) for faster charging. This provides the standard output capability of a Type-C charger for recharging the key fob battery conveniently and efficiently. The designed prototype is being tested to ensure universal compatibility with various types of Type-C chargers, further enhancing user experience. Furthermore, the paper discusses some of the modern wireless technologies aimed at vehicle key systems with their significant challenges and solution.

articleTitle: Battery Monitoring and Control System for EV using IOT Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Electric vehicles represent a significant advancement for the automobile industry, promoting a more sustainable future with their eco-friendly approach and reduced fuel dependence. The battery is the primary source of energy for an electric vehicle. A reliable and real-time monitoring system is crucial to ensure the safety, performance, and longevity of the EV battery packs. This paper proposes an Internet of Things (IoT) based Battery Monitoring and Control System to monitor the vital parameters of electric vehicle batteries in real-time. This system utilizes the Internet of Things (IoT) to monitor and control electric vehicle functions automatically. Embedded sensors gather data which is then communicated through the Ubi Cloud protocol for autonomous management. The results depict various battery parameters, such as voltage, temperature, and humidity.

articleTitle: Attention mechanism with CNN for fingerprint and finger-knuckle based person authentication
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Biometric authentication systems play an important role in maintaining security and privacy in all areas. This research paper introduces a method of authentication by combining unique characteristics of the CASIA-FingerprintV5 fingerprint and the PolyUKnuckleV1 knuckle images. To capture the textural features found in both types of biometrics, we used local binary pattern (LBP) features. We utilize a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) to classify data generated by our proposed approach by concatenating the features of the fingerprint and the finger-knuckle to allow us to assess its effectiveness. The attention mechanism is implemented to focus on the most relevant features to prioritize the most informative part of the image. The results of our experiments indicate that the model achieved near-optimal performance, approaching its maximum potential. The outcome highlights the effectiveness of our fusion technique in enhancing the capabilities of biometric authentication systems, particularly when individual modalities may have limitations. The fusion of fingerprint and knuckle biometrics improves the resilience of the system against challenges such as sensor variations and noisy input data. This research shows promise for applications that require reliable biometric authentication, such as access control, identity verification, and forensic investigations.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach on Large Scaled Data Prioritizing Customer Relationship Management: Perspective Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: In general perspective, the activities linked to customer relationship management are accumulating, properly organizing and implementing the user supportive large scaled data intelligently with the adequate supported techniques. Considering the present situation of provisioned large scaled heterogeneous data in all respect, in this work it has been prioritized on the implementation mechanisms in customer relationship management maintaining the gaps and providing suitable solutions. Accordingly, intelligent techniques can be applied on the provisioned large scaled data integrating customer relationship management. In many situations, the processes associated with the system can be linked with supported decisions. Therefore it is important to intently monitor the performance of a decision model along with the quantification of individual decisions. The presence of specific intelligent analytical system can monitor the decision data optimizing the decisions based on the situation. As the analysis of large scaled data can be challenge towards obtaining the optimal results as well as faster decisions, in this regard, it has also been aimed to focus on these data facilitating the enhanced decision making process using soft computing meta-heuristic techniques.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing Agricultural Health: Deep Learning for Crop Disease Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Significant threats to global food security are posed by crop diseases, necessitating the adoption of innovative approaches for their early detection and management. Deep learning, recognized as a subset of artificial intelligence, has emerged as a promising tool for revolutionizing crop disease diagnosis through the analysis of agricultural images. This work assesses if deep learning can transform the area of agricultural health particularly regarding crop infection analysis. Using a dataset from the Plant Village, this paper develops a deep learning model and through review of the literature, assesses the effectiveness of the deep learning model in crop disease identification and classification into categories found in leaf descriptions. The method included several explanation steps comprising data apparition, model building, training, with evaluation. Outcomes have been very effective in displaying the efficacy of deep learning models to accurately diagnose crop infections.

articleTitle: Securing the Future of Electronic Health Records with Blockchain Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The use of blockchain technology is meant to revolutionize the way in which traditional systems work. This technology has paved way for more secure solutions thereby leveraging the concepts of data privacy and authentication. Electronic health records are digitally stored health data of the patients which includes their history of diagnosis along with their reports generated by the hospitals. But these records also face the concerns of data privacy and security as they are prone to tempering, leakage and duplication. To address these concerns researchers have come up with the use of blockchain in electronic health records. Since blockchain is a decentralized and immutable ledger-based platform, it offers more secure and private solutions to the healthcare sector. This paper presents a framework based on blockchain for EHRs in order to enhance their security. It also makes use of Interplanetary file system as a distributed data storage platform which is compatible with Web 3 based environments. This addresses the issue of scalability of the system. The proposed framework proves to be better in terms of privacy, scalability, security and cost when compared with the recent literatures. This system can further be extended by integrating multi-factor authentication as a future direction for research.

articleTitle: Handwritten Character Recognition and Vehicle Number Recognition using OCR Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Handwritten character recognition is a fundamental problem in pattern recognition and machine learning with numerous applications in diverse fields. Vehicle registration name-plate recognition is the most important part of the identification of vehicles. The present methods are time-consuming and require manual operations. We proposed a model for handwritten pattern identification and Vehicle number plate recognition using the Optical Character Recognition (OCR) Method. We conducted the experiments in Python and the results and presented. In the future, the proposed method can be extended for other Indian languages and Automatic detection of number plates using other Machine Learning methods.

articleTitle: Earthquake Early Magnitude Prediction Using 3D Point Cloud Based Deep Learning Model: Case of 2018 Osaka Earthquake
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Earthquakes are considered to be one of the deadliest natural phenomena that exist on Earth. The destruction during an earthquake is directly related to the magnitude corresponding to a station during the earthquake. The magnitude of an earthquake is calculated from the complete time series recorded by the instrument. In recent years, the early phase of the time series has been used to measure an earthquake’s magnitude, commonly known as an earthquake early warning system. This early detection of magnitude gives sufficient time for saving lives and property damaged by the earthquake. Traditionally, simple linear relations are utilized in the EEWS. In this study, the proposed Point Cloud Magnitude Prediction (CloudMag) model utilized point cloud technology, which converts two-dimensional time series data into multi-dimensional representation in space. This representation is then utilized for earthquake magnitude prediction using a convolutional neural network architecture. This study discusses a case of the deadly Osaka earthquake that occurred on 18 June 2018 at 7:58:35 AM Japan Standard Time. The result shows that the novel deep learning approach for magnitude estimation is superior to traditional and other machine learning models.

articleTitle: Bridging the Black Box: Interpreting Transformer Attention in High-Stakes Medical and Legal AI
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Transformer models have transformed many areas of research, showing exceptional performance in natural language processing and other areas. Their applications in high-stakes areas like healthcare and legal systems face a critical barrier: interpretability. As “black-box” systems, these models often lack the transparency required for stakeholders to understand their decision-making processes, which is crucial in scenarios where errors can have severe consequences. We introduce a novel framework that boosts the interpretability of transformer models through advanced attention visualization techniques. It is tailored to the needs of medical and legal domains, bridging the gap between raw model outputs and actionable insights. The approach incorporates domain-specific contextual layers, letting users pinpoint and understand key factors driving the model’s decisions. For example, attention maps produced by the framework can bring to the fore important regions in medical images or critical phrases in legal documents, thereby inducing trust and accountability. Overall evaluations using case studies in medical imaging with the CheXpert dataset and legal document analysis with the CaseLaw dataset illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach. The results show significant improvements in both performance and interpretability with high accuracy, precision, and recall achieved alongside clear visual explanations. This work advances the field of explainable AI by enabling the responsible and ethical integration of transformer models into critical applications, ensuring that these systems are not only high-performing but also transparent and trustworthy. This new framework will set a standard for the ethical and effective use of AI in high-risk domains.

articleTitle: Prevention of Road Accidents by Using Li-Fi Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The best way to lower car accidents is vehicle-to-vehicle communication. According to this study, light-emitting diode bulbs are the main tool used to implement Li-Fi technology. Data is transmitted via light’s spectrum to act as an optical wireless channel for signal propagation. By using this technology, many lives can be saved and traffic accidents can be prevented. To facilitate communication between cars traveling within a touching distance of one another, an ultrasonic distance-detecting sensor is utilized. This Li-Fi is used to transfer data between cars. Text, video, and other types of data can all be sent over Li-Fi. This concept can be carried out as economically and efficiently as possible. LED-based lighting is widely utilized in daily activities today. Because of its benefits, including quick switching, high power efficiency, and safety for human vision, it may also be used for communication. Therefore, this project will address visible light data transmission between automobiles that is ecologically benign. The visible light is composed of white LEDs that transmit audio signals to the receiver. VLC has a promising future and enhances existing RF communication by becoming more efficient.

articleTitle: Analysis of Hybrid PV and FC System with Boost Converter Using Intelligent MPPT Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: A hybrid fuel cell (FC) and photovoltaic (PV) system that is augmented with a boost converter and an intelligent maximum power point tracking (MPPT) controller is examined in this study. Integrating PV and FC with an MPPT controller ensures optimal power extraction from both sources, even under varying environmental conditions. The use of a boost converter helps stabilize the output voltage, maximizing power delivery to the load. Intelligent MPPT techniques, such as hybrid P&O MPPT controller, dynamically adjust the converter’s duty cycle, improving efficiency and response to solar irradiance fluctuations. Simulation studies in MATLAB/Simulink demonstrate that this hybrid control approach improves power stability, minimizes oscillations, and adapts effectively to real-time variations. The proposed intelligent MPPT-driven hybrid system shows promise for high-efficiency applications, providing a reliable power supply with optimized energy management from renewable sources.

articleTitle: Design and Development of Secure CAN Bus Communication Protocol for Industrial Field Devices using Indigenously Developed VEGA Processor
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: An Industrial Control System (ICS) is a type of information system that is used in various industries. The convergence of Information Technology (IT) and Operational Technology (OT) has made it easier for businesses to integrate and have visibility of their supply chain, including crucial assets, operational procedures, logistics, and planning.In recent years, there has been a significant increase in the development of autonomous vehicles, such as self-driving cars. To enable communication between the various components in automotive systems, Robert Bosch developed an electronic communication bus called Controller Area Network (CAN). The CAN protocol is also used in electronic equipment for aviation and navigation, mechanical control, and industrial automation, among other applications. Communication networks are used in the process industry to exchange information between sensors, actuators, and controllers. However, the absence of encryption and authentication makes the CAN vulnerable to various attacks, which can lead to disastrous mishaps and monetary loss. The paper presents a security-enhanced CAN bus communication protocol using an indigenously developed VEGA processor. The VEGA THEJAS32 is a 32-bit processor, that is based on the open-source RISC-V Instruction Set Architecture, which serves as the basis for these high-performance processors. The VEGA processor is compact and effective, with a 3-stage, in-order RISCV processor core.

articleTitle: A Novel Modified Shuffled Frog Leaping Algorithm (MSFLA) MPPT Controller for Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The exhaustion of fossil fuel reserves and increasing environmental issues have intensified the need for renewable energy. The focus on enhancing solar energy efficiency is particularly strong among various renewable sources. In photovoltaic (PV) systems, temperature and solar irradiance are crucial factors that significantly affect performance, making it essential to operate these systems at their maximum power point. Specifically for PV systems operating in partial shade, this study introduces a new method for improving the performance of Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT) controllers. The proposed method integrates a Modified Shuffled Frog Leaping Algorithm (MSFLA) with the MPPT controller to maximize power extraction from PV panels. Inspired by the social dynamics of frog populations, the MSFLA has been tailored to address the complexities of partial shading, which often results in multiple local maxima on the power-voltage curve. Comparative analysis reveals that MSFLA achieves the highest tracking speed and output power accuracy among bio-inspired optimization algorithms, achieving an efficiency of 99.24%.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach towards Vehicle Lane Tracing using Auto Vision Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This article introduces a new method for tracking vehicle lanes using sophisticated visual recognition methods. The swift advancement of self-driving technology makes precise lane detection and tracking essential for secure and dependable vehicle navigation. The method suggested involves using different computer vision algorithms such as edge detection, color space transformation, and Hough Transform to precisely locate and follow lane markings under different road conditions. Furthermore, machine learning algorithms are incorporated to improve the system’s ability to manage obstacles like occlusions, changing lighting conditions, and complicated road structures. The system is intended for use in modern autonomous vehicles, operating in real-time. Thorough testing in various settings proves the efficiency of the method, indicating notable enhancements in both accuracy and processing speed when compared to traditional techniques. This research work helps advance safer and more dependable self-driving systems with a new approach for detecting lanes and guiding vehicles.

articleTitle: Enhancing PV System Performance with Irradiance-Responsive Converter Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The proposed research strategy aims to conduct a comprehensive investigation and optimization of power electronic devices utilized in the context of renewable energy applications, specifically focusing on solar and wind power systems. The primary objectives of this study encompass an in-depth analysis of the performance and efficiency of a diverse range of power electronics components, including converters, inverters, and controllers, with a specific focus on identifying areas with potential for enhancement. To achieve these objectives, advanced simulation software will be leveraged to develop sophisticated models and rigorously assess the operational characteristics of power electronics devices under varying conditions, accounting for parameters such as load fluctuations, temperature variations, and input voltage disparities. Furthermore, this research will intricately delve into the intricate interplay between different power semiconductor materials, device configurations, and control strategies, with the overarching goal of discerning their collective influence on the overall performance and efficiency of power electronics devices. The ultimate aspiration is to distil and propose the most promising design and control strategies capable of effecting substantial improvements in the efficiency and reliability of power electronics devices tailored for application in the realm of renewable energy.

articleTitle: High Performance Rooftop Solar PV Arrays Design and Implementation for Maximised Renewable Energy Output
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The global electricity demand and changing lifestyle have increased the electricity demand by 0.05 percent from 2023–2024. The global carbon footprint has also an adverse effect on the production of electrical power from classical sources like hydro power, thermal power, and nuclear power. The progress in semiconductor technology particularly solar cells has dragged the attention of power engineers to think about harvesting solar energy which is abundant in nature. In this research article, an attempt has been made to design and develop a rooftop solar power plant of 354kW peak. The present research work focuses on meeting the residential energy demand of the studied institution by generating solar-based power. The paper deals with strategic planning and development from the grassroot level to the final interconnection and pumping of power through the institution substation. The result and evidence present in this research work have been carried out by PVsyst software and HOMOR pro. The validation of the software model has been carried out with the actual 354kW setup in the studied institution.

articleTitle: Hand gesture to speech Empowering Communication for the Speech Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The need for sign language interpreters makes it difficult to communicate effectively with deaf and mute people. The goal of this research is to create a deep learning model that can translate visuals in sign language into text and speech to address this. We propose a system that can convert sign language movements into comprehensible output by using a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), which is renowned for its excellent accuracy. The goal of this deep learning application is to improve communication between those with normal hearing and those who have hearing loss.

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation of Smart Biogas Bottling Plant Using IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This paper is to concentrate, on the generation of energy based on biodegradable wastes from domestic and cattle wastes. The intention of this paper is to attenuate biodegradable wastes and generate a feasible alternative to liquid petroleum gas (LPG). The demand for monitoring and control processes is increasing day by day due to environmental issues. Better monitoring and control algorithms can be verged and proposed in this paper by using the Internet of Things (IoT). It will be used to predict the present level of biogas to manage the input accordingly. With the help of IoT technology phones receive data instantaneously. It is one of the decentralised sources of energy in future. Retained Kitchen waste leads to public health hazards, so this paper assists in avoiding various diseases like malaria, and typhoid and also meets the social concerns in our society. This work provides a suitable means for biogas production with a smart and continuous monitoring system.

articleTitle: ADMT: ACO-based Data Management Technique for IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Context: ICN (Information Centric Network) is a content-centric network that enables communication in the network by using content names. Each content is retrieved and cached inside the network using the content name rather than the address of the content. This enables content retrieval from the neighbor nodes and decreases the burden of reaching the content producer every time. Objective: Objective of the proposed work is to improve the cache hit ratio and reduce the content retrieval delay of IoT networks by using ICN in-network caching and placing content at the efficient nodes.Method: Proposed work uses an ACO (Ant Colony Optimization) based caching technique, which enables the caching of the content at the efficient node by considering the node capabilities and position. This technique uses pheromone level and heuristic information to select the best path to reach the cache node. Resulsts: Proposed work is evaluated using the ndnSIM simulator, and the results are evaluated regarding CHR (Cache Hit Ratio) and CRD (Content Retrieval Delay). The proposed work approximately achieves 5 to 8% efficiency in CHR and reduces 7% of CRD. Conclusion: The proposed work is an efficient caching technique that uses ACO to enhance cache node selection and path section in IoT.

articleTitle: Performance Enhancement of Charge Scheduling Algorithm using Greedy Method
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The development of electric vehicles (EVs) has underlined the need of fast, reasonably priced, grid-stable charge scheduling schemes. This work maximizes EV charge scheduling using a Greedy Algorithm to solve dynamic electricity pricing, changing charging station availability, and changing grid conditions. The method achieves a compromise between charging cost, time, and grid stability using a multi-objective optimization framework. Time window constraints, grid load limits, minimum State of Charge (SoC) required to consider charging stations enable one to locate suitable charging options for every EV. Implementing regionally ideal decisions at every level helps the method schedule EV charging sessions to maintain grid stability and reduce costs and wait times. With the complexity and dynamic character of EV charge scheduling, this practical and computationally efficient solution benefits consumers and grid operators.

articleTitle: Environmental Monitoring in Hospitals Using IoT and Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Hospital environmental monitoring is essential for maintaining regulatory compliance, preventing infections, and guaranteeing patient safety. Conventional techniques for keeping an eye on environmental factors including temperature, humidity, air quality, and noise levels are frequently time-consuming and labor-intensive. This research offers a novel strategy that improves the effectiveness and precision of environmental monitoring in hospital settings by utilizing deep learning and the Internet of Things (IoT). We suggest an all-inclusive system in which real-time data on several environmental parameters is continuously collected by IoT sensors. After that, this data is sent to a centralized cloud-based processing platform. The gathered data is analyzed using deep learning algorithms, which find patterns and abnormalities that can point to possible risks or inefficiencies. Predictive analytics is also integrated into the system to estimate future environmental conditions and give hospital management useful insights.

articleTitle: Digital Capability Curves Of Salient Pole Synchronous Generators
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: A speeding Car always displays its Prime Parameters in different Meters on its Dashboard in real time. The safety and performance limits are depicted in the background of those meters. The Stator current Vector of a synchronous machine traverses a semicircular path as the Apparent Power varies from Zero P.F. lagging load to Zero P.F. leading load. But the study of stability of a machine is of prime importance when connected with the Grid. Different parameters govern the stability and capability of that machine viz., Power angle, Field current, Stator current, Prime Mover output, Saliency limit, Direct and Quadrature Axis Reactance, etc., A Generator is capable of operating Stably within the Graphs of above Parameters without losing synchronism from the Grid. If not for the limiting factors the alternator would be operable within the contour of the semicircle. This Capability curve was first firmed up by Dr. J.H. Walker in 1950’s. Dr. Walker defined the limiting factors graphically. In this paper these graphs are digitalized and a very comprehensive Capability curves can be drawn just by entering values of X<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</inf>, X<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">q</inf>, Rated Power Factor and terminal voltage E of the Generator in p.u. It is unique in the sense that by entering 4 key values, the Capability curve gets contoured within the boundaries of above limiting factors. Larger the area contoured in the semicircle better is the capability of the machine.

articleTitle: Improving Word Sense Disambiguation By Adopting Refined Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Word sense disambiguation (WSD) is an important subfield of Natural Language Processing (NLP) that helps in determining the correct sense of a word in a sentence based on the context. Certain words have different meanings depending on their context, and misinterpretations of these words can lead to ambiguity. Ambiguity can create uncertainty about the meaning of a sentence, leading to misunderstandings in the communication. This paper explores different WSD approaches, focusing their efficiency, specifically in terms of accuracy and computational resources. While significant progress has been made, there are still some challenges including shortage of labeled datasets, especially in low resource languages. This highlights the necessity for advancements in WSD techniques to improve their effectiveness.

articleTitle: Optimizing Residential Solar Energy Usage through Hybrid On-Grid Solar PV System with PSO MPPT: An Implementation Study
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This study focuses on developing a hardware prototype to optimize residential solar energy utilization. The research specifically proposes the design of a hybrid on-grid photovoltaic (PV) solar system using Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) integrated with Maximum Power Point Tracking (MPPT). The hybrid system employs efficient MPPT through the combination of grid-connected and standalone solar PV components. The PSO MPPT algorithm enhances power generation and system performance. Experimental setup and hardware implementation demonstrate the system’s capability to maximize solar energy harvesting while maintaining grid connectivity. Results indicate that this prototype offers a functional and sustainable solution for residential energy efficiency, reducing reliance on conventional grid power sources and lowering energy costs.

articleTitle: A Novel VGG-XGB Model for the Comprehensive Detection and Classification of Apple Leaf Diseases Using Transfer Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: The vital role of growing apples in global farming, both for their nutritional and economic power, shows the need to tackle diseases hitting apple orchards. Using technology, especially computer-aided diagnosis systems, offers a great way to boost the spotting and sorting of diseases. This gives big gains to the farmers by upping the quality and yield of their apples. Bringing tech progress to protect apple orchards from diseases ensures a steady flow of top-notch apples for folks worldwide. This helps the Apple business grow & flourish. Pursuing technological advancements in farming, especially through computer-aided diagnosis systems, represents a significant technological breakthrough and a critical step toward ensuring the sustainability and productivity of apple farming. The goal of this research is to implement a comprehensive approach to the detection and classification of diseases in apple leaves. This proposed methodology incorporates the Wiener filter for noise removal, which boosts image clarity and adaptive thresholding for segmenting the images to find the infected areas. The VGG-16 model helps to extract the key features from the images, and XG-Boost (Extreme Gradient Boosting) is used to closely sort the different apple leaf diseases. Together, these advanced techniques have hit an impressive accuracy rate of 95.90%, showing how good this integrated approach is at boosting disease management strategies for apple orchards.

articleTitle: Seamless Interaction through Gesture Recognition: Integrating Virtual Canvas, Keyboard, Calculator And Mouse with Voice Assistance on a Unified Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This paper discusses the project ‘Seamless Interaction through Gesture Recognition,’ which is a system designed for the human-computer interaction without touching any tool, it simulates it virtually through three gadgets: a gesture-controlled mouse with voice recognition facilities, an air-based keyboard, calculator and a drawing canvas. In order to interpret the hand movements, gestures, and voice commands that are captured by the webcam and microphone, the system applies computer vision, machine learning, and speech recognition technologies. Hand motions made by the virtual mouse communicate to the computer what actions are to be done and where to locate the cursor. Additionally, the computer recognizes the voice commands which are an aide to such usage. The virtual keyboard, on its part, suggests finger positions through the air as keystrokes, virtual calculator processes a calculation based on hand gestures, and the virtual drawing tool is the one that notices the hand actions that it changes into digital artwork. All of these were developed by the OpenCV and MediaPipe frameworks, the programs that allow correct real-time hand tracking and gesture identification. The findings are a valuable contribution to computer interaction formation, which can lead to a decrease in the use of physical interaction devices and a shift to more natural interaction methods.

articleTitle: Real time Blood Pressure Detection System using YOLOv3 method
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: A critical indicator known as blood pressure gauges the force of blood on artery walls as the heart pumps blood throughout the body. It is the most important sign of stroke, renal failure and heart disease. WHO suggests public health policies and monitoring controlling the Blood pressure of patients. And it highlighted a concern about high blood pressure or hypertension in 25% of people affecting low and middle income countries. The blood pressure prescribed using the Yolov3 technique and several BP measuring techniques were investigated. We have explored various methods for taking blood pressure measurements. Using Python’s Yolov3 function, ultimately this effort can be expanded to real-time blood monitoring based on an IoT system for controlling and measuring pressure.

articleTitle: Enhancing Urban Mobility: Deep Learning-Based Traffic Sign Assistant for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Urban mobility presents significant challenges for visually impaired individuals, particularly in interpreting and navigating through traffic signs. In response, this paper introduces a novel Traffic Sign Assistant (TSA) system empowered by deep learning technology to aid the visually impaired in comprehending traffic signs and enhancing their mobility in urban environments. The proposed TSA system leverages state-of-the-art deep learning models, notably convolutional neural networks (CNNs), for real-time detection and recognition of traffic signs. Through robust deep learning algorithms, the system can accurately identify various types of traffic signs, including regulatory, warning, and informational signs, overcoming challenges such as variations in lighting conditions and occlusions. Evaluation of the proposed TSA system involves comprehensive testing and user feedback sessions to assess its effectiveness in real-world scenarios. Results demonstrate the system’s ability to significantly improve the mobility and safety of visually impaired individuals in urban environments by providing timely and accurate interpretation of traffic signs. This research contributes to the advancement of assistive technologies tailored to the needs of the visually impaired, offering a promising solution to enhance urban mobility and accessibility through the integration of deep learning-based traffic sign assistance systems.

articleTitle: Enhanced Detection and Classification of PCB Defects Utilizing Advanced YOLO Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: In rapidly growing industries, speed and accuracy in manufacturing products has become paramount. In electronics production, particularly in Printed Circuit Boards (PCBs), detecting and classifying defects is crucial to ensuring product reliability and quality. PCBs are highly sophisticated, and defects are often imperceptible to the naked eye. To address this challenge, various data augmentation techniques were applied to the dataset to enhance model training. These techniques enabled the model to learn essential features, facilitating faster defect localization and classification into different categories. This research presents an advanced methodology for PCB defect detection using the latest version of YOLO (You Only Look Once) integrated with specialized enhancements. These enhancements include the Convolutional Block Attention Module (CBAM), an attention mechanism, and an Intersection over Union (IoU) based loss function. These additions significantly improve the model’s ability to accurately detect defects by minimizing false negatives. Experimental evaluations were conducted with YOLO versions 8, 9, and 10, demonstrating that integrating CBAM and the IoU loss function yields promising results compared to traditional YOLO models. This paper provides manufacturing companies with a powerful mechanism to enhance efficiency and product quality through automated PCB defect detection techniques.

articleTitle: Enhanced Appliance Disaggregation Using UNet-NILM: A Comparative Study on UK-DALE and BLOND Datasets
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This paper presents an improved approach to appliance disaggregation using the UNet-NILM model, evaluated on the UK-DALE and BLOND datasets. The preprocessing of the UK-DALE dataset involved handling irregular time steps and missing data by resampling to a consistent 6-second interval and applying quantile filters to smooth the signals. The BLOND dataset, although pre-summarized to one-second intervals, required additional preprocessing to identify consistent appliance usage patterns and optimize window sizes and thresholds. The performance of the UNet-NILM model, featuring 7-layer down- and upsampling blocks, was compared to a 1D-CNN baseline, demonstrating superior disaggregation accuracy across multiple appliances, particularly for complex devices like washing machines and dishwashers. Both models were trained using identical hyperparameters, with the UNet-NILM model showing significant improvements in Mean Absolute Error (MAE), Normalized Disaggregation Error (NDE), and Estimated Accuracy (EAC) over the baseline. Experiments on the BLOND dataset further validated the scalability and robustness of the UNet-NILM model when applied to a more challenging dataset with varying appliance combinations. The results underscore the potential of UNet-NILM in achieving higher disaggregation accuracy, contributing to more effective energy monitoring and management systems.

articleTitle: Vāṇī: An Integrated Framework for Revitalization of Native Indian Languages
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: As a culturally rich country, India is known for its linguistic diversity. The country’s languages translate directly into its traditions, heritage, and history. Urbanization and globalization, the influence of Western cultures and modern media have led to opportunistic situations which resulted in major languages like English. There is a decline in the use of native languages within families and societies, and this has resulted in many of the indigenous languages of India losing their potency. Over 220 languages may have been lost in the last five decades and around 600 languages come under the endangered bracket. Therefore, this study aims to preserve and improve the perception of Indian languages through storytelling. The solution “Vāṇī” consists of an application and device which helps users converse in their native languages regularly to increase engagement and sustain cultural awareness sustainably.

articleTitle: The Importance of Data Annotation for Autonomous Drone Navigation
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Amidst the rapid advancements in drone technology, data annotation stands as a crucial element for enhancing autonomous drone navigation, a key factor across diverse applications such as urban surveillance and environmental monitoring. This paper delves into the crucial role that high-quality, precise data annotations play in training drones to perform intricate navigational tasks independently. By enabling drones to accurately recognize objects, interpret diverse environments, and make real-time navigational decisions, annotations directly influence drone efficiency and operational safety. The reliability of autonomous drones in complex environments hinges on the robustness of the annotated datasets. These datasets must encompass a wide range of scenarios to teach drones to navigate through various challenges, from avoiding obstacles in flight to adapting to sudden environmental changes. However, the annotation process encounters significant hurdles, including ensuring data integrity, maintaining annotation accuracy, and scaling the data to meet extensive training needs. Furthermore, the paper explores innovative solutions to enhance the annotation process, such as automated tools that leverage artificial intelligence to increase annotation speed and accuracy. It also examines the integration challenges of annotated data within existing drone systems and discusses strategies to improve data scalability and processing. Conclusively, the paper argues that advancing data annotation techniques is essential for the future development of drone technology. As drones assume more autonomous roles in critical operations, ongoing improvements in data annotation will be key to unlocking their potential, ensuring they operate safely and effectively across diverse and unpredictable environments.

articleTitle: Enhancing Battery Management Systems in the Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT): An In-depth Exploration of Energy Efficiency, Predictive Analytics, and Intelligent Maintenance Approaches
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Battery management systems (BMS) are essential in the fast developing IIoT domain for guaranteeing the efficiency, lifetime, and dependability of energy storage solutions. With the proliferation of IIoT devices across many industries, there is a growing need for sophisticated BMS systems that can optimise energy usage, anticipate battery performance, and enable intelligent maintenance. Improvements in energy efficiency, predictive analytics, and intelligent maintenance approaches are the primary foci of this research as it pertains to the IIoT ecosystem and BMS. Our first step is to investigate ways that IIoT devices can be made more energy efficient. This includes things like optimising the charging and discharging operations of batteries and using adaptive power management techniques. We want to keep IIoT devices running longer and lessen their impact on the environment by making the most of BMS’s energy efficiency. Our second topic is the function of predictive analytics in predicting the state of a battery’s health and output. Models are created using machine learning algorithms and big data analytics to forecast battery deterioration patterns, identify impending failures, and plan proactive maintenance to reduce maintenance expenses and downtime. We conclude by exploring intelligent maintenance approaches that can deliver BMS valuable insights through the use of real-time data and advanced analytics. A combination of these methods—which include automated maintenance procedures, remote monitoring, and self-diagnostic devices—improves the performance and dependability of IIoT battery systems. This paper examines the present and future of BMS in the IIoT through a thorough literature analysis, case studies, and experimental validation. The insights it provides are quite significant. In light of these results, data-driven methods have the ability to transform battery management, guaranteeing that IIoT devices can continue to withstand the increasing demands of industry while being environmentally friendly, efficient, and robust.

articleTitle: A DDS-Based SFCW Ground Penetrating Radar System for Subsurface Object Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: This paper presents the design and implementation of a high-resolution Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR) system utilizing Stepped-Frequency Continuous Wave (SFCW) signals for advanced subsurface detection. Operating within the 0.5 GHz to 2 GHz frequency range, the system employs a 20 MHz step frequency to balance penetration depth and spatial resolution, enabling precise identification of subsurface targets. The core detection methodology is based on the A-scan technique, which captures time-domain reflections to deliver real-time localization of buried objects. The system integrates sophisticated digital signal processing (DSP) techniques, including IQ demodulation, pulse integration, and Inverse Fast Fourier Transform (IFFT), enhancing the Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) and improving detection accuracy, even in environments with significant subsurface clutter. These techniques provide high sensitivity for resolving weak reflections and enhance range resolution for detailed target identification. Validated in complex environments with varying soil properties, the system demonstrates superior ability to differentiate between hazardous targets, such as landmines, and non-hazardous objects like pipes and voids. Its advanced clutter rejection and signal fidelity make it well-suited for humanitarian demining and other critical subsurface scanning tasks. The system’s high-performance imaging and robust signal processing framework position it above conventional GPR systems, particularly in heterogeneous and cluttered environments.

articleTitle: Augmented Reality: Enhancing Collaboration and Design Across Spaces
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Augmented Reality was first invented in 1968, since then it is rapidly transforming and impacting all the touches we make onto this digital world in our daily lives. It is an interactive experience that combines the virtual reality and the physical world. From making the learning process more productive to facilitating all the shopaholic, AR has made a remarkable impact. However, we have experienced AR single handedly, but a very critical aspect of the Collaborative Usage and Physical Environment Requirements has been somewhat overlooked such as User Interface Complexity, Technical Limitations, Privacy and Security concerns, Lighting and Environment Clutter. To ensure the fulfilment of the users demands, it is necessary to examine their requirements and feedback and categorize the methods used for AR advancements so that practitioners and researchers will be equipped to develop suitable applications. This paper presents a theoretical framework derived from the previous research of the most efficient methods for AR. Methods are grouped according to the application domains and we reviewed user requirements and challenges and proposed the required methods and solutions to be adapted resulting the enhancement in the existing system. Additionally, we have talked about AR implementation using Mobile Phones and Robotic Device. This approach should facilitate the evolution of the AR technology and ultimately becoming accessible to a broader audience. Lastly, we discussed the limitations and further scope of enhancements for the future working of our project.

articleTitle: FitTip: Merging Technology and Fitness for Posture Improvement
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Poor form is a primary contributor to exercise-related accidents, which can result in permanent physical handicap and deter people from maintaining a regular fitness regimen. This study suggests FitTip, an intelligent posture identification and correction device that uses computer vision and machine learning, as a means of preventing these kinds of injuries. Using a proprietary dataset of yoga and gym routines, we developed a convolutional neural network (CNN) integrated with the Mediapipe framework to accurately categorize and correct workout positions in real time. Position analysis is used in FitTip’ s design to provide real-time feedback and change recommendations. The algorithm was evaluated on a dataset of five workout poses, and the results indicated that it could get 98.73% training and validation accuracy. These findings show how well algorithm works to improve overall fitness results and workout safety. The suggested algorithm offers a framework that is scalable for enhancing posture during activity, and it may eventually be integrated with wearables and fitness applications. It includes a real-time camera feed for pose detection, a key-point detection module, and a feedback algorithm that suggests corrections based on the angles between body joints. This paper also addresses challenges such as limited dataset size and variability in user movements, proposing solutions through enhanced preprocessing and pose analysis techniques. FitTip algorithm makes training safer and more accessible for people of all fitness levels, which adds to the expanding field of fitness technology.

articleTitle: A Novice Approach to Predict Obsessive Compulsive Disorder by using AIML Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 Third International Conference on Trends in Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Engineering (TEECCON)
abstract: Obsessive Compulsive Disorder is a serious psychological health condition featured by continuous thoughts and monotonous episodes, accordingly, impacting one’s daily life condition. With Early plus accurate prediction of OCD can lead to immediate diagnosis and better patient outputs. This analysis focusses to attain a model for OCD using machine learning techniques applied to a comprehensive dataset comprising demographic, clinical, and behavioural data. We gathered datasets from a varied group of participants, which included individuals with OCD as well as a control group without the disorder. Several machine learning algorithms were implemented and evaluated based on their predictive accuracy. The results highlight the potential of machine learning to improve early OCD diagnosis, providing clinicians with a promising tool to help create personalized treatment plans.
